coverage.summary: Applies to foreclosed properties containing one or more residential rental units after foreclosure sale or transfer of title. Owner-occupied two- and three-family units are not exempt from the 90-day notice.
coverage.owner_conditions: Owner-occupied two- and three-family units are not exempt from the 90-day notice requirement.
coverage.other_conditions: Triggered by foreclosure and the sale or transfer of title of a property containing residential rental units.

result.notes: I removed the posting-instead-of-individual-notice rule for buildings with more than 10 units from the summary. It describes how notice is delivered (landlord conduct), not which buildings are covered. I also removed the month-to-month tenant point, because it concerns tenancy type rather than buildings, units or owners. I set min_units to 1 based on the phrase 'one or more residential rental units'. All other coverage fields stay null because no supporting passage exists in the documents.
